adequacy_rationale: Exploratory 95% intervals require at least ten effective draws per 2.5% tail (ESS 400), no single draw exceeding tail probability, and stable disjoint half-batch summaries. These necessary screens do not certify tail ESS or unseen-mode coverage. Report failed corrections as diagnostics only.
reference_design: If any joint importance screen fails: bounded symmetric random-walk Metropolis in fixed local Gaussian coordinates, step 2.38/sqrt(50), no adaptation. Reject outside bounds; constant affine Jacobian cancels. Four starts: selected MAP, alternative accepted fit, and two feasible local perturbations. A short feasibility experiment, not a promised converged reference. Diagnose all 50 whitened coordinates, log target and sampled density/projection summaries. No truth/withheld tuning.
evaluation: Reuse frozen Sobol and projection queries, foreground 5% truth peak. Density and acquired/withheld latent intervals; proper 95% interval score (lower better), mean relative L2, width and coverage. Weighted outputs remain labelled unreliable if adequacy fails. No noisy predictive coverage claim.
